name: Wandee Clinic ( วันดีคลินิก ฟิลเลอร์ ขอนแก่น )

summary_en: Wandee Clinic in Khon Kaen specializes in filler treatments and plastic surgery, holding a 5.0-star rating from 5 reviews. The clinic has been referenced in 3 Pantip discussions regarding facial contouring and rhinoplasty advice. It currently maintains a trust score of 58.4.
